connections.notes: Fresh feed: (1, 1, 1) mol/s at 300 K and P_r, liquid (derivation §4).
Adiabatic mixer outlet. The v0.0 closure is restricted to the subcooled-liquid domain; derivation §7 finding 5 shows no registered r-variant leaves it.
Heater outlet at the specified temperature. Two-phase in three of the five registered variants (derivation §7 finding 2), which is a supported result.
Vapor product. Exactly zero flow in the 310 K variant; ZERO_FLOW is a phase signature, not a failure (ADR 0001 D3.4).
Flash liquid at the flash temperature and pressure.

Liquid recycle. Its T and P are known from the flash specification, so the tear needs only its three component flows; T01 must rediscover that from the incidence graph rather than have it hard-coded (plan §3.2).
Purge. Together with S4 it carries the whole external product balance.

description: Two-phase flash, liquid heater outlet, all three recycle streams flowing. The reference values are in benchmarks/syn001/reference_values.yaml; the algebraic reference is benchmarks/syn001/oracle.py. Case SYN-001-capped-budget reuses this revision unchanged and differs only in a solve-policy override in the registry.

policy.fidelity: boundary condition; the fresh feed state is fully specified

pressure_drop.meaning: Declared pressure drop across the mixer; zero in SYN-001, imposed as an equation P_out = P_in rather than assumed (ADR 0001 D4.5)

policy.fidelity: adiabatic component and energy balance; enthalpy closure by a bracketed scalar thermal solve
policy.validity: v0.0 restricts the closure to the subcooled-liquid domain with a typed failure outside it (plan §3.2)

pressure_drop.meaning: Declared pressure drop across the heater; zero in SYN-001, imposed as an equation P_out = P_in rather than assumed (ADR 0001 D4.5)

policy.fidelity: TP-state outlet: a TP flash at the specified outlet temperature with the duty as a calculated unknown of either sign
policy.validity: SYN-001 declared domain; a two-phase outlet is a supported result

pressure_drop.meaning: Declared pressure drop across the flash; zero in SYN-001, imposed as an equation P_out = P_in rather than assumed (ADR 0001 D4.5)

policy.fidelity: isothermal-isobaric equilibrium flash sharing the heater's TP-state kernel; duty calculated
policy.validity: SYN-001 declared domain; single-phase and zero-flow results are supported outcomes, not failures (ADR 0001 D3.4)

split_fraction.meaning: Fraction r of the flash liquid returned to the mixer; the purge takes 1 - r. Pinned by specification SPEC-splitter-r.

policy.fidelity: linear split at constant T, P and composition
policy.validity: 0 <= r < 1; r = 1 has no steady state (derivation §5)

policy.fidelity: boundary; accepts a stream and imposes no equation on it
policy.validity: accepts any phase signature including ZERO_FLOW

specifications.notes: Fresh-feed component molar flow. The registered throughput scale is the fresh-feed total, 3 mol/s (derivation §9).
Fresh-feed component molar flow. The registered throughput scale is the fresh-feed total, 3 mol/s (derivation §9).
Fresh-feed component molar flow. The registered throughput scale is the fresh-feed total, 3 mol/s (derivation §9).
Fresh-feed temperature. Equal to T_r, so the fresh-feed enthalpy flow is exactly zero at P_r in the SYN-001-ref-v1 reference convention (ADR 0001 D5.1).
Fresh-feed pressure. All pressure drops in SYN-001 are zero, so every stream is at this pressure.
Heater outlet temperature. The duty is the calculated unknown and may be negative (ADR 0001 D4.2); specifying the duty as well is the over-specification of case SYN-001-conflicting-heater-spec.
Isothermal flash temperature, shared by both outlets. The flash duty is the calculated unknown.
Split fraction returned to the mixer. Must equal the splitter instance's split_fraction parameter binding; tests/test_schemas_p01.py asserts that.
